task: What is the approximate Heart Rate Reserve of a 50 year old man who has a heart rate of 60bpm at rest.
answer:
FINAL: Approximately 110 bpm. Wolfram|Alpha's Karvonen heart rate reserve formula gives HRR = (220 − age) − resting heart rate = (220 − 50) − 60 = 110 bpm. Its result shows age 50 years, gender male, resting heart rate 60 bpm, and heart rate reserve 110 bpm.
Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=heart+rate+reserve+50+year+old+man+resting+heart+rate+60+bpm
